reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how music transitions in Provincia. Instead of abrupt cuts, our new system features a long equal-power self-crossfade that makes the music feel seamless, especially during day, night, title, and combat scenarios. This change enhances the overall immersive experience of managing your colony. Learn more about the update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
